**Job Overview:**  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and delivery of scalable, cloud-native applications. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong expertise in Node.js, React, AWS, and Microservices, capable of leading high-performing development teams while making key architectural decisions.  
You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams to build secure, reliable, and high-performance software solutions. This role combines technical leadership, solution architecture, and hands-on development while mentoring engineers and driving engineering excellence.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Technical Leadership**  
● Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration,  
innovation, and continuous improvement.  
● Drive technical strategy, architecture, and engineering best practices across projects.  
● Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security, and quality  
guidelines.  
● Guide technical decision-making and resolve complex engineering challenges.  
● Collaborate with Product Managers to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.  
● Participate in sprint planning, technical estimation, release planning, and backlog  
refinement.  
● Identify technical risks, manage technical debt, and recommend long-term architectural  
improvements.  
● Support production releases and participate in incident analysis and resolution when  
required.  
**System Design & Microservices**  
● Lead the design and architecture of scalable, secure, and highly available applications using  
modern software architecture principles.  
● Drive High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions, ensuring  
alignment with business and technical objectives.  
● Design, develop, and optimize Microservices, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures  
for enterprise-scale applications.  
● Architect scalable asynchronous workflows and inter-service communication using  
messaging and event-streaming technologies.● Define API standards, service contracts, and integration patterns to ensure interoperability and maintainability across distributed systems.  
● Ensure system scalability, fault tolerance, resilience, observability, performance, and  
reliability through industry best practices.  
● Evaluate and recommend architectural improvements, technology choices, and design  
patterns to support long-term platform growth and engineering excellence.  
**Full-Stack Development**  
● Lead the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise-grade web applications using Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript.  
● Develop scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, and reusable frontend components  
following industry best practices.  
● Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.  
● Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and DevOps teams to  
deliver high-quality software solutions.  
● Define and maintain API contracts, integration patterns, and coding standards to ensure  
seamless communication between frontend and backend systems.  
● Conduct code reviews, mentor developers, and promote engineering best practices across  
the development team.  
● Troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive continuous improvements in application  
architecture, performance, and maintainability.  
**Cloud & DevOps**  
● Design, architect, and deploy scalable, secure, and highly available applications on AWS  
using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, and  
CloudWatch.  
● Collaborate with DevOps teams to design cloud-native infrastructure, deployment strategies, and production environments.  
● Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, automated, and efficient  
application deployments.

AWS environments.  
● Monitor application and infrastructure health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and  
centralized logging solutions.

PostgreSQL).● Implement caching strategies using Redis.

● Ensure application scalability and efficient resource utilization.

**Required Skills:**

distributed systems.

● Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, cloud-native application development, and  
scalable infrastructure.  
● Experience with Docker, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; exposure to Kubernetes is  
preferred.  
● Strong knowledge of MongoDB and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.  
● Experience with caching technologies such as Redis and performance optimization

● Solid understanding of application security, API security, OWASP best practices, and secure

● Databases: MongoDB, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis
